Name: Villager Name Replacer (With Translations)
Author: ApollyonSV
Description:
[center][b][u][size=5]About This Mod[/size][/u][/b]

[size=4]Well...after 5 years, I'm finally ready to start on the release for the Villager Name Replacer compatible with translations! This is a separate mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url] since there is a lot of lost functionality such as gender and birthdays. But I [b]do[/b] plan on adding birthdays back in a later update! This initial release adds 39 villagers in 6 supported languages you can change the name and nickname. Check the bottom of the page for a list! Thanks for checking it out![/size]

[b][size=4]Please note that this is a very early release and there will be many mistakes and errors on my part so please make sure to report any problems and I'll fix them. [/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Check out my [url=https://ko-fi.com/apollyonsv]Ko-Fi[/url] if you'd like to support me!
[/b][/size]

[b][size=5][u]Future Roadmap[/u][/size][/b]

[size=4]- Add more language support -[/size]
[size=4]- Add birthdays -[/size]
[size=4]- Add more villagers -[/size]
[size=4]- Create resource files for users to easily replace an existing villager -[/size]
[size=4]- Other mod support -[/size]
[size=4]- Open to suggestions on other features -[/size]



[u][b][size=5]Installation[/size]
[/b][/u]
[size=4]- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you don't have it already
- Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. I highly recommend this as it will make configuring the in game changes a whole lot easier
- Download Villager Name Replacer
- Unpack the contents of the archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder using a program such as WinRAR

*If you have the Generic Mod Config Menu downloaded, just click on the lower left cog button on the main menu screen, find Ultimate Villager Manager, and make changes there. Don't forget to save and close!

Launch the game and enjoy![/size]

[b][u][size=5]Credits[/size]

[/u][/b][size=4]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2078512]OkaMoez[/url] for allowing me to use the original name replacer mo[size=4]d to [/size]get to where I am today. I'm glad I can continue to keep it updated and keep the idea alive. If not for you, I probably would never have gotten this far in to Stardew modding *[/size]
